title: prepend_path_header splits entire article into Vec<&[u8]>
description: O(N) ALLOCATION ON INGESTION HOT PATH — prepend_path_header (ingestion.rs:184) calls article_bytes.split(|&b| b==b'\n').collect() to build a Vec<&[u8]> of all lines before scanning for Path:. This allocates a heap Vec proportional to the number of lines in the article on every ingest, even for articles whose Path: header is in the first two lines. Fix: replace the split+collect with a direct line-by-line scan that stops as soon as Path: is found or the blank line is reached, eliminating the Vec allocation entirely.
